violation_type.title: Personal use of electronic devices, cell phones, MP3 players, and video games. Cell phones briefly used and supervision is maintained (26 TAC §747.1501(c)(4)(C))
violation_type.short_title: Personal use of electronic devices, cell phones, MP3 players, and video games. Cell phones briefly used and supervision is maintained
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, a caregiver was using their cell phone for personal tasks not associated with caring for the children.

finding_variants.text: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, a caregiver was using their cell phone for personal tasks not associated with caring for the children.
It was determined that a caregiver was using her cell phone throughout the day for personal use.
During the course of an investigation, it was determined that the caregiver stepped in the breezeway to utilize the phone. The phone calls last for more than 30 minutes.
A caregiver in the home had an airpod in their ear while caring for children.

Based on the information collected throughout the investigation, it is concluded that the caregiver engaged in personal use of electronic devices (cellphone) during periods when active supervision of children was required.
